preconditions.description: The size of the matrix N must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cell <= 100 for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must contain a number between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == N and all(len(row) == N for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix must be of size N*N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of decreasing paths modulo 10^9+7.
